laterBaseline.review: All tokenVault, IacPool, IMasterChef, IGovernor and ReentrancyGuard files exactly match the original generation. SafeERC20 transfer helpers use the same nominal transfer model; v5.2 uses low-level assembly, error propagation and true-or-empty success checks. All later source files are compared in full to this pinned separately reviewed baseline.

methodReview.deposit: Harvest before exact amount safeTransferFrom; records nominal amount less deposit fee; existing referral retained; no received-balance measurement.
methodReview.claim: selfHarvest accrues each selected full position before funding fees, updates debt, splits gross OINK by wallet/miner payout, tracks referral points.
methodReview.withdraw: Full indexed position only; rewards accrue before funding fees; position swap/popped; nominal remaining principal transferred to sender.
methodReview.emergency: Full indexed position only; funding fee applies, position removed, all OINK forfeited; no harvest; Withdraw event uses penalty field for returned nominal principal.
methodReview.fundingFee: Whole hours from max(lastAction,lastFundingChangeTimestamp), amount * hours * rate / 1000000, capped at 20%; transfer to treasury; decrement position amount.
methodReview.referral: Zero referral input preserves existing referredBy; claim/withdraw add paid OINK amount to sender/referrer referralPoints.

limitations: This evidence verifies vault behavior and pinned public state. It does not establish token transfer behavior or safety, authorize broadcasting, or activate application permissions.
Deposit-token runtime hashes and decimals are observations only; token source/proxy/fee verification is a separate requirement.
MasterChef, Governor and OINK runtimes match existing pins; they are not independently recompiled by this script.
Mutable values must be rechecked at every transaction review. No transaction was broadcast or simulated with a wallet account.
